title: GigaSpeech 3: Scaling Multi-Dialect Arabic Speech Recognition with Weakly Labeled Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.02476v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dialectal Arabic speech recognition remains constrained by the scarcity of dialect-resolved transcribed speech despite the abundance of web audio. We introduce GigaSpeech 3, a corpus of 39,000 hours and 10 million weakly transcribed speech segments covering Algerian, Egyptian, Iraqi, Saudi, and Syrian Arabic. Starting from 60 hours of manual transcription per dialect, we train labeling models using speech-recognition-biased self-supervised learning and apply them to dialect-matched web audio. Data selection and four rounds of noisy-student refinement for Saudi and Syrian Arabic yield the final corpus. We validate its utility through dialect-specific and multi-dialect speech recognition training and cross-domain evaluation. On GigaSpeechBench, the final dialect-specific models outperform their labeling models across all five dialects and achieve a macro-average word error rate of 23.86%, a 16.6% relative reduction from the strongest third

translated_title: GigaSpeech 3：利用弱标注数据扩展多方言阿拉伯语语音识别
translated_abstract: 方言阿拉伯语语音识别一直受到方言标注转写语音稀缺的制约，尽管网络音频资源十分丰富。我们提出了GigaSpeech 3，这是一个包含39,000小时、1000万个弱转写语音片段的语料库，涵盖阿尔及利亚、埃及、伊拉克、沙特和叙利亚五种阿拉伯语方言。从每种方言60小时的人工转写出发，我们使用偏向语音识别的自监督学习训练标注模型，并将其应用于方言匹配的网络音频。通过数据筛选以及对沙特和叙利亚阿拉伯语的四轮噪声学生训练精炼，最终得到该语料库。我们通过方言专用和多方言语音识别训练以及跨领域评估验证了其价值。在GigaSpeechBench上，最终的方言专用模型在全部五种方言上均优于其对应的标注模型，实现了23.86%的宏平均词错误率，相比最强的第三方（模型）实现了16.6%的相对降低。
tldr: 研究者构建了包含39,000小时弱标注数据的大规模多方言阿拉伯语语音语料库GigaSpeech 3，通过自监督学习与噪声学生训练策略，使方言专用语音识别模型的宏平均词错误率达到23.86%，相对最强第三方模型降低16.6%。
en_tdlr: GigaSpeech 3 is a 39,000-hour weakly labeled corpus covering five Arabic dialects, built via speech-recognition-biased self-supervised learning and noisy-student refinement, enabling dialect-specific ASR models that achieve a 23.86% macro-average WER, a 16.6% relative reduction over the strongest third-party models.
